summary: Cookie Consent Banner (Law 25) testing complete. 10/11 features working correctly. One bug found: Footer 'Cookie Settings' button clears localStorage but banner does NOT re-appear immediately without page reload.

ui_bugs.issue: Cookie Settings button in footer clears localStorage but banner does NOT re-appear immediately. Requires page reload to show banner again. Root cause: Footer and CookieConsentBanner use separate instances of useCookieConsent hook, so state change in Footer doesn't trigger re-render in Banner.

action_items: FIX: Footer Cookie Settings should trigger banner re-appearance without page reload. Consider using a shared state/context or event-based approach to notify CookieConsentBanner when resetConsent is called.
critical_code_review_comments: CookieConsentBanner.js and Footer.js both use useCookieConsent hook but as separate instances - state changes in one don't affect the other
Potential fix: Use React Context to share cookie consent state across components, or use a custom event to trigger banner re-render when resetConsent is called
